# Risk and return

<!-- page 3 -->

## The CAPM

The expected return on asset \(i\) is
\begin{equation}
E_i = r_f + \beta_i (E_m - r_f) \tag{4}
\end{equation}
where \(r_f\) is the risk-free rate, \(\beta_i\) denotes the sensitivity of asset \(i\) to the market and \(E_m\) is the expected market return.

<!-- page 4 -->

## Sharpe ratio

For a portfolio with mean return $\mu_p$ and volatility $\sigma_p$ the Sharpe ratio is
\[
SR = \frac{\mu_p - r_f}{\sigma_p}
\]
A price of \$5 is not math.
